sloka: ततस्ते राक्षसाः सर्वे नर्दन्तो जयकाङ्क्षिणः।अभ्यवर्षंस्ततो घोरान् वानरान् शरवृष्टिभिः ।। ६.७३.२९ ।।
transliteration: tataste rākṣasāḥ sarve nardanto jayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ।abhyavarṣaṁstato ghorān vānarān śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ ।। 6.73.29 ।।

translations.english: Flaming like fire god, endowed with the prowess of Indra, possessing inconceivable form, Indrajith with his bow, arrows and chariot disappeared into the sky.
